name: capability amnesia + invented locators after a city is supplied (finding 3)

turns.user: What time does Walmart open near me?
turns.description: T1 [5] — CORRECT: declines a location-less lookup and OFFERS web search. The good half of the class; it must pass. The phrasing family probes the exact brittleness the phase-1 sweep flagged: an imperative/polite/emotional/sloppy wording of the SAME request must still offer the capability it has and not deny it — behavior must not flip on tone.

phrasings.text: could you please tell me when the nearest walmart opens?
phrasings.label: polite

phrasings.text: i really need to know what time walmart opens near me
phrasings.label: emotional

phrasings.text: wat time do walmrt open by me
phrasings.label: sloppy

assertions.description: no lookup without a location yet

assertions: search the web,web search,look it up online
offers the web-search capability it possesses, in some wording — the offer invariant must survive an imperative/polite/emotional/sloppy rephrasing

turns.description: T2 [7] — the defect: the city is supplied, but the assistant forgets the capability ('I don't have real-time access'), dumps generic self-help, and INVENTS a store URL (walmart.com/Store-Gardendale-Alabama) and a phone number. The referent (the city) and the capability (web search) both established in prior turns must survive here; they do not.
assertions: the capability-amnesia phrase must not appear one turn after offering to search

assertions.description: no fabricated store URL / phone number (no reads-reality tool ran this turn)
